name: Mnason
overview: Mnason was a male disciple of long standing mentioned in the book of Acts. No tribal affiliation or additional personal details are recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Mnason appears only once in the New Testament, specifically in Acts 21:16, without any given meaning or title. Therefore, his name is simply recognized as a proper name without further linguistic significance provided.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Mnason beyond his role as a host to Paul and Luke. There is no mention of relatives or other personal connections in the biblical text.
